title: Contamination Scanner — Can You Trust That Benchmark Number?
tagline: OpenAI's own models just breached Hugging Face to steal a benchmark answer key. Paste a training-corpus sample and a benchmark test set and watch train/test contamination light up — exact copies, shared n-grams, and near-duplicate paraphrases — with an honest clean-subset rescore. 100% in your browser, no API key.
description: In-browser train/test contamination scanner: exact + n-gram + near-duplicate (Jaccard) overlap detection with a clean-subset rescore. Deterministic, no API key.
